scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @inmobiliaria/api" "npm run dev -w @inmobiliaria/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @inmobiliaria/api && npm run build -w @inmobiliaria/web
scripts.test:regressions: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/web/lib/api.test.ts apps/web/lib/public-data.test.ts apps/web/lib/catalog-filters.test.mjs scripts/format-date.test.mjs scripts/payment-config-policy.test.mjs apps/api/src/payments/payment-config.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: c8 npm run test:unit && node scripts/normalize-lcov.mjs
scripts.test:python-coverage: python -m coverage run --branch --include=scripts/smoke-dev-vps.py -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_*.py && python -m coverage xml -o coverage/python.xml
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:regressions && npm run test:payments && npm run test:sonar-gate && npm run test:web-components
scripts.sonar:up: docker compose --profile sonar up -d sonar-db sonarqube
scripts.sonar:scan: docker compose --env-file .local/sonar.env --profile sonar --profile sonar-scan run --rm sonar-scanner
scripts.sonar:local: npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:python-coverage && npm run test:web-errors && npm run sonar:scan
scripts.test:payments: npm run build -w @inmobiliaria/api && node --test apps/api/dist/auth/auth-policy.test.js apps/api/dist/auth/jwt.strategy.test.js apps/api/dist/config/runtime-config.test.js apps/api/dist/storage/antimalware.service.test.js apps/api/dist/storage/file-validation.test.js apps/api/dist/payments/payment-config.test.js apps/api/dist/payments/payments.service.test.js scripts/payment-config-policy.test.mjs
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres minio minio-init
